company.name: Klarna
company.shortDescription: Klarna is a global digital bank and flexible payments provider.
company.description: Klarna is a global digital bank and flexible payments provider. With over 114 million global active Klarna users and 3.4 million transactions per day, Klarna’s AI-powered payments and commerce network is empowering people to pay smarter with a mission to be available everywhere for everything. Consumers can pay with Klarna online, in-store and through Apple Pay & Google Pay. More than 850,000 retailers trust Klarna’s innovative solutions to drive growth and loyalty, including Uber, H&M, Saks, Sephora, Macy’s, Ikea, Expedia Group, Nike and Airbnb. Klarna is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: KLAR).

aiResearchSummary.text: Klarna is researching dynamic discovery and application of stored-value tokens, as described in 'Dynamic discovery and application of stored-value tokens,' which details obtaining requests for stored-value tokens usable in web-based exchanges and identifying supported providers. This work focuses on enabling users to apply stored-value tokens during online transactions, highlighting Klarna’s development in facilitating digital payment solutions.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Post IPO Debt round raised $1,030,040,561, or 11.19% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 34 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $45,500,000,000 to $6,700,000,000, a 0.15x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 72 (-11 over 90 days) and market heat at 57 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Affirm, Afterpay, Zilch.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
